calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: I was impressed. AI can even make phone calls. The future is here. But the person taking the request at the other end was human. Wait, what a sudden change, from science fiction to a workplace drama. Still, the main point is not, so it was a person after all. The question is whether people were clearly told that a new person had joined. Meta was testing some calls made through MUSE. Trained contract workers made these calls and finished the conversations with the other person. They tested a setup where MUSE passed the work to a human helper. People didn't handle every call. So it is too soon to put up a caption saying, actually, people did it all.
